The Snackbar at the End of the World

name: The Snackbar at the End of the World
summary: A bittersweet story of love, defiance, and… pasta? As a chef in magical 1960s Italy you take over a struggling restaurant to save your family in this hand-drawn, narrative adventure RPG. Face explosive tomatoes, chaotic zucchini, and vendetta-driven poultry - then use them to cook the perfect dish.
